whatsNew.title: What's new?
whatsNew.subtitle: Recent improvements to profiles, events, matchmaking, payments, and internationalization.

profilePhotos.title: Profile photos and logos
profilePhotos.body: Promoters, managers, and gyms can upload photos or logos and manage their fighters' photos.

events.title: Publish events
events.body: Promoters and managers can create and publish fight cards from their dashboard.

matchmaking.title: Automatic and manual matchmaking
matchmaking.body: The engine recommends matchups, and the organizer can confirm, reject, modify, or manually create a bout.

reliability.title: Complete fighter profiles
reliability.body: Profiles combine discipline, weight class, record, team, country, and social media in a compact view.

analytics.title: Analytics dashboard
analytics.body: Promoters and managers can review activity, participants, and event operations.

payments.title: Registration payments
payments.body: Events support connected payments and manual confirmation for transfers or cash.

directory.title: International directory
directory.body: Athletes, gyms, and professionals can be found by country and discipline.

languages.title: Spanish, English, and Russian
languages.body: The international interface adapts to each user's selected language.

hero.description: Connect with athletes, coaches, gyms, and organizers.
hero.detail: Everything you need, from finding a fight to organizing an event, all in one place.
hero.signature: Strikers Match. Where the next fight begins.

about.title: About us
about.communityBody: Strikers Match is built to connect the international combat sports community: athletes, coaches, gyms, managers, promoters, sponsors, and event professionals.
about.missionBody: We make it easier to find fights, publish events, complete fight cards, and locate the services needed to operate combat sports events in any market.
about.workBody: The platform offers public profiles, directories, registration tools, matchmaking, and event operations. Strikers Match provides technology that facilitates connections; it is not a promoter, organizer, coach, or sanctioning body.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For support or questions about your account, profiles, events, or the directory, contact the Strikers Match team.

pricing.title: Platform tools
pricing.subtitle: Features for creating events, registering athletes, matching fighters, managing bouts, and printing event sheets.
pricing.studioDescription: Production tools for preparing local cameras, graphics, and broadcast operations from the event.
